results.summary: This design implements a 4x4 structural array multiplier in Verilog that multiplies two 4-bit numbers to produce an 8-bit product. It generates partial products using two-input AND gates and sums them column by column with full adders, propagating carries between stages. The design is purely combinational and is intended as an educational exercise for a university digital design course. Testing is done by applying 8-bit input values and comparing the output to the expected product.
